verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is an entity-registration service, so a non-resident or foreign-entity registration path is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack only covers the Entity Management API, API keys and accounts, plus a generic "Register your entity" prompt. Nothing documents non-resident eligibility, accepted foreign credentials or identifiers, or extra steps for foreign registrants.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
